messages:
Harpreet: FYI opened a small PR to shrink the ruby gem and make telemetry opt-in for sampleapps. installer was pulling a 10MB telemetry blob that confused users
Priya: link?
Harpreet: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ruby-sdk/pull/512 — gist: split telemetry into optional gem redwood-telemetry, remove heavy assets from main gem, and add SAMPLEAPP_TELEMETRY=0 default for quickstart
Sam: :+1: onboarding teams complained the sampleapp was contacting telemetry endpoints without clear consent. Good call to make it opt-in
Nora: CI found a style problem on pre-release branch: rubocop flagged a frozen_string_literal missing and a method length in client.rb
CI-Bot: build #3012 failed: rubocop offenses detected (files: lib/redwood/client.rb)
Harpreet: fixed rubocop nits, pushed a follow-up commit. Also added a short README paragraph to explain the telemetry split and how to enable it for analytics
Priya: question: are we sure about defaulting SAMPLEAPP_TELEMETRY=0? Marketing sometimes wants opt-out for metrics. Is legal okay with opt-in?
Harpreet: checked with legal and privacy — they recommend opt-in for sample code. We keep internal telemetry enabled by default in our demo environments only, not in the public sampleapp. Added an explicit consent prompt in sampleapp/start.rb
Sam: tiny API nit: if the optional gem is absent we should surface a clear warning at runtime (not a stacktrace). Can you add a graceful no-op logger message?
Harpreet: added a fallback logger that prints a one-line message indicating telemetry disabled and how to opt-in. Also added a unit that verifies no exception when telemetry gem missing
Nora: docs nit: please add a short migration note for users updating from < 2.1 that might have the big blob in vendor/ — instruct to run `bundle clean --force` and delete vendor/cache entries
Harpreet: added migration steps in changelog + sampleapp README and a tiny rake task to clean vendor artifacts: `rake redwood:clean_vendor`
Priya: once CI green and the wording tweak applied, I'm happy to approve. Also ping support to update onboarding troubleshooting article
Harpreet: will do the support ping and squash commits
CI-Bot: build #3013 queued
